title.zh: 有界轴对称压力电流反馈

summary: Iteratively updates plasma current from a pressure-versus-radius spline and a supplied Green matrix, returning explicit terminal status.

identity.relation: I_target=R (dP/dpsi) abs(dR*dZ); I_new=(1-relax) I_target+relax I_old; psi_new=psi_vac+G I_new. P is re-fitted from the prescribed midplane P(R).
identity.direction: rectangular R,Z grids, pressure law, vacuum flux and Green matrix to updated flux/current state
identity.definition: Pressure-only axisymmetric current closure j_phi=R dP/dpsi under psi=R A_phi. Update residual ||psi_new-psi_old||_2/abs(edge_new) is retained. New closure_residual=||I_new-I_target(psi_new,new fit)||_2/||I_target||_2, with zero target/zero error mapped to zero and zero target/nonzero current mapped to an infinite residual and nonfinite terminal failure. Converged requires both residuals <=tol. State is call-local; update fit derivative, clip, relaxed currents, Green contraction, new flux, edge/fit and both residuals in order; stop on convergence, invalid state or maxiter.
identity.model: Source-derived pressure-versus-radius feedback with InterpolatedUnivariateSpline and supplied Green matrix
identity.geometry: Finite rectangular uniformly spaced 2-D R,Z arrays with exact Z=0 midplane
identity.coordinates: Caller must supply coherent units and Green/pressure convention. The pressure-only SI interpretation is R,Z in m, P in Pa, psi=R A_phi in Wb/rad, I in A; arbitrary supplied G is not a verified physical equilibrium Green operator.
identity.boundary: 压力边界为沿物理半径向外遍历时的第一个精确零点；从轴侧至边界的磁通须严格增加。下降的存储坐标先仅将中平面拟合索引按R排序，Green双轴、电流及结果均保留调用者次序。
assumptions: Pressure-only closure; no toroidal F F-prime term, prescribed current profile or independent continuum force-balance certification.
relax is in [0,1) because relax=1 freezes zero initial currents

inputs.name: Z
inputs.constraints: Row-consistent, uniformly spaced, contains >=3 exact zero midplane points

inputs.name: Pfunc
inputs.constraints: Must provide an exact zero pressure edge

inputs.name: psi_vac
inputs.constraints: Midplane flux strictly increasing through pressure edge

inputs.name: tol
inputs.description: Threshold for both normalized flux-update and current-closure residuals

outputs.name: EquilibriumResult
outputs.description: Flux, plasma currents, final pressure fit, status, iteration count, original update residual, closure_residual and reason; immutable residual_history and closure_residual_history tuples for completed paired residual evaluations
outputs.constraints: status is converged, maxiter or nonfinite; history length may be less than attempted iterations when an update fails before residual evaluation

preconditions: All finite real rectangular uniformly spaced inputs
supported: Bounded update feedback with optional boolean plasma mask
Explicit terminal state for convergence, iteration cap and nonfinite update
Convergence cannot be triggered by a stationary flux when relaxed current still violates the pressure closure.
Coherent descending R/Z storage preserves the physical radial pressure traversal and caller-ordered outputs.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError before iteration for shape, dtype, grid, parameter, mask or contract violations.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: nonfinite status for nonfinite derivative/current/Green/fit/residual; no nonfinite pressure derivative is silently replaced by zero.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: maxiter status with last local state and residual; maxiter=0 has residual +inf.
failure_semantics.partial_results: nonfinite is explicitly not accepted; failed Green arithmetic retains the preceding finite flux/current pair. Histories contain only completed paired residual evaluations.

provenance.lineage_summary: D2 bounded successor derived from Pleiades eq_solve.py compute_equilibrium and inherited equilibrium handoff; update order and defaults preserved where supported. The predecessor used only a flux update norm and could falsely report convergence for zero G with relaxed currents. D2 successor retains that metric and additionally measures the final-state pressure-current equation before stopping. 后继修复下降R存储误把外侧零压点当首边界的索引缺陷；仅排序物理中平面拟合索引，不改Green或结果次序。 The legacy-six successor shares finite spline/current kernels with the single-step and pressure-state APIs and exposes immutable paired histories; no second iteration loop is introduced.
provenance.license_status: Source/license evidence retained; scientific and release approval pending.

python.signature: compute_equilibrium(R, Z, Pfunc: 'Callable[[float], float]', psi_vac, g_psi, tol=1e-10, maxiter=100, relax=0.0, plas_clip=None, plotit=False)

example.description: Run bounded manufactured feedback on a 2x5 grid.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.equilibrium import compute_equilibrium
R = np.tile(np.arange(1.0, 6.0), (2, 1))
Z = np.tile(np.array([-1.0, 0.0])[:, None], (1, 5))
result = compute_equilibrium(R, Z, lambda r: 5.0-r, R, np.zeros((10, 10)))
assert result.status == "converged"
example.expected: Explicit terminal result; status does not imply physical equilibrium.

scope: Manufactured update/residual and terminal status fixtures
Analytic current closure and near-unit-relaxation false-convergence regression.
Ascending/descending paired nonzero-G pressure feedback and independent derivative/current closure.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Bounded numerical contract only; no scientific approval.
known_limitations: No arbitrary pressure/Green physical closure validation
No independent continuum force-balance residual; supplied G controls the discrete model.
